dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Curatorium of Secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: If you're looking to have a commission fulfilled, just leave a note in the message book over there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's rare to find you here...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: We have an important visitor coming today, and Jahoda has taken the day off.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: As such, the Curatorium's receptionist for the day is none other than myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Would you look at the time? Our visitor should be arriving soon... I'll have to clear the place out shortly.
